istanbul.villas.jade.description1: Elegant proportions within a composed private setting.
istanbul.villas.jade.description2: Jade features approximately 294 m² of gross and 256 m² of net interior space, with land shares ranging from approximately 693 to 706 m².
istanbul.villas.jade.description3: The residences maintain a consistent relationship between their architectural footprint and private grounds, with most of the documented villas emphasizing generous lower gardens.
istanbul.villas.jade.description4: Jade offers a refined 4+1 configuration with a clear sense of proportion and privacy.
istanbul.villas.crystal.description1: A refined architectural footprint with striking variations in private land.
istanbul.villas.crystal.description2: Crystal represents the most compact architectural configuration in the development, at approximately 292 m² gross and 254 m² net.
istanbul.villas.crystal.description3: Yet its land configurations reveal a notable contrast, ranging from approximately 728 to 1,344 m².
istanbul.villas.crystal.description4: This creates the potential for remarkably different outdoor experiences within the same architectural collection—from more intimate settings to residences surrounded by substantially larger private grounds.
istanbul.villas.coral.description1: A generous 4+1 residence with room to live outdoors.
istanbul.villas.coral.description2: Coral offers approximately 348 m² of gross and 303 m² of net interior space, with individual land shares ranging from approximately 632 to 873 m².
istanbul.villas.coral.description3: The residences feature varied garden configurations, including substantial lower gardens and, in some villas, additional upper-level outdoor space.
istanbul.villas.coral.description4: Coral brings a generous architectural footprint to the 4+1 collection while maintaining a strong connection to private outdoor living.
istanbul.villas.ruby.description1: Distinctive residences shaped by their individual settings.
istanbul.villas.ruby.description2: Ruby offers approximately 411 m² of gross and 348 m² of net interior space, while its individual land shares vary considerably—from approximately 664 m² to 1,290 m².
istanbul.villas.ruby.description3: This variation gives the collection a particularly diverse outdoor character, with different residences offering different relationships between architecture, gardens and private land.
istanbul.villas.ruby.description4: Ruby is a collection where the setting becomes an important part of each residence's identity.
istanbul.villas.motherOfPearl.descriptio: Refined proportions with a variety of private landscapes.
Mother of Pearl brings together 5+1 residences of approximately 467 m² gross area, with individual land shares ranging from approximately 828 to 1,287 m².
The collection offers particularly varied garden configurations, from generous lower gardens to residences with gardens distributed across both levels.
Each residence therefore has its own relationship with the surrounding landscape while retaining a consistent architectural identity.
istanbul.villas.sapphire.description1: A generous expression of the 5+1 residence.
istanbul.villas.sapphire.description2: Sapphire offers approximately 505 m² of gross and 444 m² of net interior space, making it the largest architectural configuration within the 5+1 collection.
istanbul.villas.sapphire.description3: Land shares range from approximately 985 to 1,384 m², with individual residences offering different combinations of lower and upper garden areas.
istanbul.villas.sapphire.description4: The result is a collection where substantial interiors are complemented by equally considered outdoor living.
istanbul.villas.emerald.description1: Balanced architecture and carefully composed outdoor space.
istanbul.villas.emerald.description2: The Emerald collection features approximately 430 m² of gross and 368 m² of net interior space, accompanied by individual land shares ranging from approximately 807 to 1,166 m².
istanbul.villas.emerald.description3: The gardens vary between residences, creating different degrees of openness and connection to the outdoors.
istanbul.villas.emerald.description4: Emerald offers a balanced 5+1 living experience in which the architecture and its private setting work together as one composition.
istanbul.villas.pearl.description1: A measured balance of interior comfort and private grounds.
istanbul.villas.pearl.description2: Pearl presents approximately 413 m² of gross and 369 m² of net interior space, with land shares ranging from approximately 1,022 to 1,067 m².
istanbul.villas.pearl.description3: Several residences feature substantial lower gardens, while others introduce additional upper-level outdoor space.
istanbul.villas.pearl.description4: The collection is defined by its balanced proportions and the close relationship between the residence and its private landscape.
istanbul.villas.silver.description1: A refined 5+1 residence with generous private land.
istanbul.villas.silver.description2: Silver offers approximately 368 m² of gross and 323 m² of net interior space, while individual land shares range from approximately 1,083 to 1,391 m².
istanbul.villas.silver.description3: This creates an interesting relationship between the villa's considered architectural footprint and the generous private grounds surrounding it.
istanbul.villas.silver.description4: Silver is defined by the opportunity to enjoy substantial outdoor space without compromising the comfort and functionality of a sophisticated 5+1 residence.
istanbul.villas.diamond.description1: A Generous architecture, surrounded by exceptional private grounds.
istanbul.villas.diamond.description2: The Diamond collection pairs approximately 567 m² of gross and 474 m² of net interior space with some of the development's most generous land shares, ranging from approximately 1,201 to 1,554 m².
istanbul.villas.diamond.description3: The residences also benefit from substantial lower and upper garden areas, creating a layered outdoor setting around the architecture.
istanbul.villas.diamond.description4: Diamond is a composition of generous living space and expansive private grounds.
istanbul.villas.gold.description1: A residence defined by scale and proportion
istanbul.villas.gold.description2: The Gold collection presents the largest villa configuration at Rengi Istanbul, with approximately 685 m² of gross and 598 m² of net interior space.
istanbul.villas.gold.description3: Individual residences are complemented by private land shares ranging from approximately 1,118 to 1,503 m², with gardens distributed across different levels.
istanbul.villas.gold.description4: Gold brings together substantial architecture and generous outdoor space, creating residences designed for an exceptional sense of scale, privacy and continuity between interior and landscape.
antalya.projects.bluelife.description1: Set on Lara Turizm Caddesi just a few hundred metres from the sea, RengiAntalya BlueLife brings together contemporary residences, commercial spaces and year-round social living in one of Antalya’s most dynamic coastal areas.
antalya.projects.bluelife.tagline: Beside the blue, at the heart of life.
antalya.projects.premium.description1: Designed as a complete residential environment, RengiAntalya Premium combines spacious apartment layouts with extensive landscaping, water features, sport, wellness and everyday amenities. A large proportion of the development is dedicated to nature and shared social spaces.
antalya.projects.premium.tagline: Premium living, ready in every detail.
antalya.projects.greenlife.description1: RengiAntalya GreenLife combines the clean air of the Taurus Mountains with generous landscaping, extensive pools and functional apartment layouts, creating a calm and social residential environment where life has already begun.
antalya.projects.greenlife.tagline: Comfort, calm and nature within the same life.
antalya.projects.greenpark.description1: Built around the idea of a contemporary neighbourhood, RengiAntalya GreenPark combines low-rise architecture, generous green space and family-oriented apartments with shared social areas in a calm residential setting.
antalya.projects.greenpark.tagline: The calm of nature, the warmth of a modern neighbourhood.
antalya.projects.rengiantalya.descriptio: Set beside a vast pine forest, RengiAntalya offers a completed residential environment where nature, comfortable apartments and everyday convenience come together. Pools, landscaped social areas and commercial spaces support a relaxed daily lifestyle.
antalya.projects.rengiantalya.tagline: Next to nature, at the centre of life.

home.roi.title: BUILD YOUR FUTURE AND WEALTH
home.roi.intro: Imagine owning a home where lifestyle and opportunity come together.
home.roi.lifestyle: Wake up to Istanbul's beautiful climate, spend your afternoons discovering extraordinary restaurants, beaches, art and culture, and watch the city come alive at night. Here, every day can feel like a vacation—while your property works quietly in the background.
home.roi.global: Istanbul has a truly global soul, where Europe, the Middle East and cultures from around the world meet. Whether you're from Los Angeles, London, Dubai, Moscow, Latin America, Africa, Asia, or anywhere in the world, you'll find a city that feels both familiar and exciting.
home.roi.turkey: Add Turkey's warm, welcoming people, breathtaking landscapes and rich culture, and it's easy to see why so many fall in love with it.
home.roi.villa: Your villa can be your family's dream home, a premium rental for elite clients, or an investment with significant growth potential.
home.roi.enter: Enter while the project is being built and position yourself ahead of completion.
home.roi.appreciation: Based on projected market values, villas in this exclusive, land-limited location are expected to appreciate approximately 30–70% upon completion.
home.roi.options: And once you've captured that immediate appreciation, you can choose to sell, generate premium rental income, or continue holding your villa and benefit from potential long-term market appreciation.
home.roi.closingHold: Or hold for the future and let your investment continue to work for you.
team.heading: The People Behind Exceptional Opportunities
team.intro1: Our team brings together decades of experience across business, finance, management, public relations, and technology, with connections spanning the United States, Turkey, the Middle East, Russia, and Europe.
team.intro2: We help clients discover opportunities that align with their lifestyle, family, investment goals, and vision for the future.
team.intro3: Our approach is personal, relationship-driven, and built on trust — because the right opportunity should contribute to not only what you own, but the life you create.
team.ahmad.title: Chief Executive Officer (CEO)
team.ahmad.bio1: Based in the United States and fluent in English and Arabic, Ahmad Hussein brings decades of experience in business and finance, with a genuine passion for helping people achieve their highest aspirations.
team.ahmad.bio2: His deep connection to Turkey reflects his appreciation for its people, culture, lifestyle, and extraordinary opportunities. When he discovered this development, he saw something different—a rare combination of truthfulness, and genuine vision. That conviction inspired him to help connect people with the team behind it.
team.ahmad.bio3: His philosophy is simple: helping others achieve their highest good is the true measure of success.
team.alma.title: Chief Managing Director (CMD)
team.alma.bio1: Based in the United States and fluent in English, Russian, and Turkish, Alma brings extensive experience in business and client relations, along with a deep understanding of both American and Turkish markets.
team.alma.bio2: Known for her warm and approachable nature, Alma believes that strong relationships are built through trust, communication, and genuine care. She is passionate about helping clients navigate important decisions with confidence while making the experience personal, seamless, and rewarding.
team.alma.bio3: Her philosophy is simple: listen carefully, build trust, and always put people first.
team.muhamed.title: Global Client Consultant
team.muhamed.specialization: Private Client Relations • USA & Middle East
team.muhamed.bio1: Frequently traveling between the United States and the Middle East, Mohamed brings extensive experience in public relations and cross-cultural communication.
team.muhamed.bio2: Fluent in English, Arabic, and Spanish, he helps clients around the world understand opportunities in Turkey and discover the right opportunities for their goals and aspirations.
team.muhamed.bio3: His approach is built on trust, personal relationships, and understanding each client’s vision, helping them identify exceptional projects with strong investment potential while creating the opportunity for a better lifestyle and a brighter future.
team.vlad.title: Head of Engineering
team.vlad.specialization: Private Client Relations • Europe & International Clients
team.vlad.bio1: Based in the Netherlands, Vladimir brings a truly international perspective shaped by living and working across cultures. Fluent in Russian and English, with Dutch as an additional language, he combines extensive IT expertise with a natural ability to connect with people.
team.vlad.bio2: Having built his own life abroad, Vladimir understands the excitement and challenges of making important decisions across borders.
team.vlad.bio3: Approachable, attentive and trustworthy, he listens carefully, communicates openly and helps clients discover opportunities that align with both their investment goals and the future they envision.

team.laith.specialization: Private Client Relations • Jordan & Middle East
team.laith.bio1: Based in Jordan, Laith Al-Rawashdeh is a trusted consultant with extensive experience across Jordan and the broader Middle Eastern market, with a strong understanding of regional trends, emerging opportunities, and the cultural values that shape business and personal relationships.
team.laith.bio2: Known for his genuine character, honesty, and transparent approach, he builds strong relationships through sincere communication and a thoughtful understanding of each client’s needs.
team.laith.bio3: His approachable nature and cultural awareness allow him to create a professional experience grounded in trust, clarity, and personal attention.
team.zulfiya.title: Accounting & Finance Manager
team.zulfiya.bio1: With a strong background in accounting and financial management, Zulfiya brings precision, integrity, and a detail-oriented approach to every aspect of financial operations.
team.zulfiya.bio2: Dedicated to maintaining accurate records and supporting sound financial practices, she helps ensure efficiency, transparency, and organization across the company.
team.zulfiya.bio3: Known for professionalism and reliability, Zulfiya plays an important role in supporting the team and contributing to the company’s continued growth and success.
team.faozi.title: Global Client Consultant
team.faozi.specialization: Private Client Relations • USA & Middle East
team.faozi.bio1: Faozi excels at connecting with people, understanding what matters to them, and turning conversations into meaningful opportunities.
team.faozi.bio2: His experience across the USA and Middle East gives him a natural ability to navigate different business cultures while maintaining a personal, straightforward approach.
team.faozi.bio3: Approachable and attentive, Faozi believes the best client relationships are built through genuine communication, responsiveness, and understanding—not simply transactions.

privacy.sms.heading: Mobile Information and SMS Consent Privacy
privacy.sms.noSharing: TurkLuxx does not sell, rent, or share mobile phone numbers, telephone numbers, SMS opt-in information, or SMS consent data with third parties or affiliates for their own marketing or promotional purposes.
privacy.sms.providers: Mobile information and SMS consent data may be processed by authorized service providers solely as necessary to deliver communications requested or authorized by the user, subject to applicable privacy and data protection requirements.
privacy.sms.optIn: SMS opt-in data and consent will not be shared with third parties for marketing purposes.
privacy.marketing.heading: Marketing Communications
privacy.marketing.body: Where permitted by applicable law, TurkLuxx may contact you regarding properties or developments you have requested information about, similar opportunities, new developments, property updates, appointments, consultations, invitations, and TurkLuxx marketing communications. Communications may be sent by email, telephone, SMS/text message, WhatsApp, or other contact methods you provide. For SMS/text messages, message frequency varies and message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out of text messages or HELP for assistance. You may opt out of marketing communications at any time. Opting out of marketing communications does not prevent TurkLuxx from responding to an existing inquiry, appointment, request, or other service-related matter through a legally permitted method of communication.
